records.name: Indian Health Board of Minneapolis, Inc.
records.what: An Urban Indian Organization funded by the Indian Health Service. The Indian Health Service lists it as offering a medical clinic with a full range of outpatient care and outpatient behavioral health care.
records.who: American Indian and Alaska Native people living in or near the city. Ask what proof of tribal affiliation or descent it needs.
records.start: Call and ask how to become a patient or client, and which services are offered at the site nearest you.
